# @stackline/esprima

Canonical documentation: https://alexandro.net/docs/vanilla/esprima/
Repository: https://github.com/alexandroit/stackline-esprima
npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@stackline/esprima
License: BSD-2-Clause

Current public release: 1.0.0
Compatibility target: esprima@4.0.1
Runtime dependencies: none
Runtime support: Node.js 8 or newer and direct browser loading
Type support: first-party declarations validated with TypeScript 3.9 and current

Public API:
- parse(code, options, delegate)
- parseScript(code, options, delegate)
- parseModule(code, options, delegate)
- tokenize(code, options, delegate)
- Syntax
- version (compatibility value 4.0.1)

Grammar scope: ECMAScript 2017 with experimental JSX, matching Esprima 4.0.1.
The Stackline package version is independent from the preserved API version.
